reason: A DSH integration plugin that imports Codex project sessions and synchronizes Codex skills, instructions, configuration, and MCP server definitions in both directions.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH 与 Codex 之间导入项目会话，并双向同步技能、配置和 MCP 服务。
summaries.en: Imports Codex project sessions into DSH and synchronizes skills, configuration, and MCP servers between the two environments.

capabilities: Reads Codex skills, instructions, configuration, and session history from local files
Imports and reattaches Codex sessions in DSH
Writes or updates Codex MCP configuration for reverse integration
Mirrors configured MCP servers between Codex and DSH
Injects local instructions and configuration summaries into prompts
